cases.title: Return to discovery when evidence is weak
cases.prompt: Run strategic design with a discovery result that has no meaningful outcome, sparse vocabulary, and no concrete scenarios.
expected_outcomes: Return the exact ddd-discover handoff or bounded stop
Identify missing outcome, vocabulary, and evidence
Do not create validated contexts
forbidden_outcomes: Treat a vague label as adequate evidence

cases.title: Classify subdomains as hypotheses
cases.prompt: Map a claims domain with evidence that fraud detection differentiates the business, billing supports operations, and identity is a commodity capability.

evidence: expert rationale and examples for each capability

expected_outcomes: Record core, supporting, and generic classifications with rationale
Keep each classification a proposed or validated hypothesis with evidence and revisit signals
Produce a domain map without designing aggregates

cases.title: Preserve context-specific meanings
cases.prompt: Strategically model a project where account means a billing relationship in one area and an authenticated identity in another.

evidence: billing and identity owners define different meanings

expected_outcomes: Record separate term meanings by context
Add conflict or translation notes and provenance
Avoid forcing one global definition
forbidden_outcomes: Use the conflict to choose a deployment architecture

cases.title: Keep bounded context distinct from deployment
cases.prompt: Define a bounded context for underwriting when the requester suggests making every context a microservice.

evidence: underwriting has coherent policy language and decision ownership

expected_outcomes: Define a model/language boundary with rationale
State that deployment is a separate decision
Evaluate operational evidence before recommending a service split
forbidden_outcomes: Treat current modules as domain truth

cases.title: Record relationship direction and translation
cases.prompt: Map a policy context that supplies approved limits to a settlement context that consumes them.
expected_outcomes: Record policy as upstream and settlement as downstream
Document ownership, contract, translation, consistency, and failure assumptions
Preserve uncertainty where communication details are unknown

cases.title: Preserve user-authored strategic artifacts
cases.prompt: Update a domain map and context map that contain user-authored sections, a filename collision, an ambiguous traversal-like context label, and an unclear ownership change.

evidence: existing documents have owners and provenance
new proposal conflicts with a context filename
a proposed label normalizes ambiguously or resembles path traversal

expected_outcomes: Preserve existing content and ownership
Ask before destructive, ambiguous, structural changes, collision replacement, or unsafe slug normalization
Use additive sections and record conflicts or stale status
Verify a resolved context path stays directly under docs/ddd/contexts before writing
forbidden_outcomes: Overwrite or rename a context silently
Write a context artifact outside docs/ddd/contexts

cases.title: Invalidate downstream assumptions after new evidence
cases.prompt: New evidence shows two proposed contexts share a consistency invariant previously modeled as independent.

evidence: new domain-expert scenario requires immediate shared consistency
existing tactical and adoption assumptions are independent

expected_outcomes: Mark affected tactical and adoption stages or artifacts stale
Record the new evidence and boundary uncertainty
Route review back to strategic design before tactical work continues
forbidden_outcomes: Claim boundaries remain validated without review

cases.title: Do not override discovery non-fit
cases.prompt: A discovery result says not-fit for a simple catalog, but a requester asks for bounded contexts without new evidence.

evidence: stable CRUD and no complex policy

expected_outcomes: Preserve the not-fit result
Return a bounded decision request or exact ddd-discover handoff
Require new evidence or explicit user direction before strategic modeling
forbidden_outcomes: Create contexts to satisfy the request
Present generic DDD guidance as project evidence

cases.title: Select one context for tactical handoff
cases.prompt: Two bounded contexts are sufficiently validated for a strategic objective, but the next tactical slice must be bounded to one context.

input.objective_priority: settle the currently approved claim flow
evidence: the objective prioritizes settlement for this slice
both contexts have concrete scenarios and ownership

expected_outcomes: Select exactly one context using the explicit objective and evidence
Emit a ddd-tactical request for the selected context only
Record the other ready context without including it in the tactical bundle
forbidden_outcomes: Pretend the other context is unvalidated
Choose silently when the objective or user priority does not support a material selection
